title: The Extended [C II] under Construction? Observation of the Brightest High-z Lensed Star-forming Galaxy at z = 6.2
question: Can [C ii] 158 um be detected to confirm the spectroscopic redshift of the strongly lensed z~6.2 galaxy MACS0308-zD1, and what do its [C ii] line components, dust continuum non-detection and ISM properties show?

data.sensitivity: Cube rms 0.27 mJy/beam per 30 km/s bin (varies by up to a factor 2.4 between tunings); continuum rms 8.9 uJy/beam

what.value: Source-plane analysis: photometric redshift 6.21, bright clump radius r = 27 pc, Sigma_SFR ~ 900 Msun/yr/kpc^2, magnification mu ~ 20, SFR_UV = 3+/-1 (zD1.1) and 7+/-2 (diffuse)

evidence.quote: The bright clump was found to have a radius of $r=27\,\rm{pc}$ in its source plane
applying a magnification factor of $\mu\sim20$ (cite: Welch2023)

what.value: Identification of the target as the brightest image (MACS0308-c4.3) of a triply imaged z>6 galaxy

evidence.quote: which originally given the ID of MACS0308-c4.3 in (cite: Acebron2018)

what.value: Photometric redshift estimate z_ph ~ 6.2-6.3 and apparent brightness m_AB = 23.0 mag

evidence.quote: an estimated photometric redshift of $z_{\rm ph}\sim6.2 - 6.3$ (cite: Salmon2020)

what.value: Local-galaxy SFR-L[CII] relation and high-z no-evolution relation used for comparison

evidence.quote: consistent with the SFR-$L_{\rm [CII]}$ relation derived in the local galaxies (cite: delooze2014)
but deviates from the “\[C ii\]-deficit” relation suggested in some of the previous studies (cite: Harikane2020; Liang2023)

recipe.goal: Image a line-search cube from all four tunings
recipe.method: tclean cube with natural weighting, 30 km/s channels, 0.1 arcsec pixels, 30x30 arcsec image; deconvolution to 3x rms with niter 500
key_parameters: natural weighting; 30 km/s binning; 0.1 arcsec pixel; 30x30 arcsec image

recipe.goal: Detect [C ii] and measure the spectroscopic redshift
recipe.method: Search for the line using the rest-frame UV position as a spatial prior

recipe.goal: Image the dust continuum and derive an IR luminosity limit
recipe.method: Multi-frequency-synthesis continuum image excluding the spw with [C ii]; 3 sigma upper limit from pixel rms; modified blackbody to L_IR; SFR_IR and obscured fraction
key_parameters: Dust temperature 45 K (also 60 K and 80 K tested), beta = 1.8, mu = 20
assumptions: Dust emission co-spatial with the galaxy; dust temperature is the major uncertainty

recipe.goal: Extract [C ii] moment-0 map, spectrum and total flux
recipe.method: Iterative moment-0 and masked spectrum extraction until the channel range converges; total flux from 2D Gaussian fit with imfit
key_parameters: Mask: pixels >2 sigma in the moment-0 map

recipe.goal: Decompose the [C ii] line into narrow and broad components
recipe.method: Least-squares two-component Gaussian fit to the integrated 1-D spectrum; component moment-0 maps from separate frequency ranges
key_parameters: Narrow map 263.62-263.72 GHz; broad map 263.73-263.92 GHz

recipe.goal: Derive L[CII], molecular gas mass and gas surface density
recipe.method: L[CII] to M_H2 with the Zanella et al. method; Sigma_H2 assuming the clump radius r = 27 pc
key_parameters: Lensing magnification mu = 22 applied to the Table values (except flux densities)
assumptions: Narrow [C ii] associated with the UV-bright clump of radius 27 pc

recipe.goal: Compare with SFR-L[CII] relations and test virial and outflow interpretations
recipe.method: Place zD1.1 on the SFR-L[CII] plane using SFR_UV = 3+/-1 and negligible SFR_IR; virial velocity dispersion sqrt(GM/3r) for the narrow component
assumptions: Virial equilibrium for the narrow component
